# Vendored Markdown renderer

`marked.mjs` is the unmodified ES module distribution of Marked 17.0.5.
Source: https://github.com/markedjs/marked/tree/v17.0.5
License: MIT, reproduced in MARKED_LICENSE.md.

It runs at documentation build time only. Vendoring keeps the build independent
of npm and leaves the delivered HTML/CSS/JavaScript fully self-contained.
